 const src=a.createBufferSource(),g=a.createGain(),f=a.createBiquadFilter();src.buffer=buf;f.type='highpass';f.frequency.value=2800;g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol,a.currentTime);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,a.currentTime+dur);src.connect(f);f.connect(g);g.connect(a.destination);src.start()
}
function bgmDrum(style,step){
 if(style==='drive'){if(step%4===0)beep(72,.06,.014,'sine',46);if(step%2===1)bgmNoise(.004,.025)}
 else if(style==='thump'){if(step%4===0)beep(88,.07,.018,'sine',54);if(step%4===2)bgmNoise(.003,.035)}
 else if(style==='water'){if(step%4===1||step%4===3)bgmNote(88,.045,.004,'sine')}
 else if(style==='chip'){if(step%4===0)beep(120,.035,.007,'square',90)}
 else if(style==='cut'){if(step%2===0)bgmNoise(.003,.025)}
 else if(style==='pop'){if(step%4===0)beep(105,.04,.008,'sine',70)}
 else if(style==='soft'){if(step%4===0)beep(95,.04,.005,'sine',70)}
}
function bgmTick(){
 const p=BGM[currentBgmKey];if(!p)return;const i=bgmStep++,mel=p.mel[i%p.mel.length],bass=p.bass[i%p.bass.length];
 bgmNote(mel,.10,.010,p.wave);if(i%2===0)bgmNote(bass,.15,.008,'triangle');bgmDrum(p.drum,i)
}
function scheduleBgm(){
 if(bgmTimer){clearInterval(bgmTimer);bgmTimer=null}const p=BGM[currentBgmKey];if(!p)return;
 const tempo=p.tempo*(1+(currentBgmLevel-1)*.045),ms=60000/tempo/2;bgmTimer=setInterval(bgmTick,ms);bgmTick()
}
function startBGM(key,level=1){stopBGM();currentBgmKey=key;currentBgmLevel=level;bgmStep=0;scheduleBgm()}
function setBgmLevel(level){currentBgmLevel=level;scheduleBgm()}
function stopBGM(){if(bgmTimer){clearInterval(bgmTimer);bgmTimer=null}currentBgmKey=null}

function waterAmbience(){
 const a=audio();if(!a)return()=>{};
 const len=a.sampleRate*2,buf=a.createBuffer(1,len,a.sampleRate),d=buf.getChannelData(0);for(let i=0;i<len;i++)d[i]=(Math.random()*2-1)*.45;
 const src=a.createBufferSource(),filter=a.createBiquadFilter(),gain=a.createGain();src.buffer=buf;src.loop=true;filter.type='lowpass';filter.frequency.value=900;gain.gain.value=.018;
 src.connect(filter);filter.connect(gain);gain.connect(a.destination);src.start();return()=>{try{src.stop()}catch(e){}}
}

  let mult=feverTime>0?2:1;

  $('#gScore').textContent=score;

 }

  if(distance>=FINISH){banner('FINISH!','초고속 장거리 코스 완주!');raceFinishFanfare();setTimeout(()=>endRace(true),1350);return}
  if(time<=0){endRace(false);return}
  raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop)
 }

  const tpActual=hero.tp-tpBefore;

  return {learned,hpGain,mpGain,tpGain:tpActual,tpCapGain,atkGain,defGain}

function ensureScoreBonusUnlocks(){
 const newly=[],n=Number(state.todayScore)||0;
 if(n>=500000&&!state.unlock.racing){state.unlock.racing=true;newly.push('racing')}
 if(n>=1000000&&!state.unlock.fantasy){state.unlock.fantasy=true;newly.push('fantasy')}
 if(newly.length){
  const q=Array.isArray(state.pendingBonusUnlocks)?state.pendingBonusUnlocks:[];
  state.pendingBonusUnlocks=[...new Set([...q,...newly])];
  save()
 }
 return newly
}

function localDateKey(){
 const d=new Date(),y=d.getFullYear(),m=String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0'),day=String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
 return `${y}-${m}-${day}`
}

 }

 const learned=rememberQrGpsAnchor(code);
 if(acquiredByAny(code)){
  if(learned)save();
  st.textContent=learned?`${g.name} QR 확인 · 이 위치를 GPS 기준점으로 저장했소!`:`${g.name}은 이미 획득했소!`;
  st.className='qrStatus ok';tone('coin');renderGpsLocations(lastGps);return true
 }
 state.qrUnlocked[code]=true;state.unlock[code]=true;save();

}
async function ensureQrDetector(){
 if(!('BarcodeDetector' in window))return null;
 if(!qrDetector){
  try{qrDetector=new BarcodeDetector({formats:['qr_code']})}
  catch(e){try{qrDetector=new BarcodeDetector()}catch(e2){return null}}
 }
 return qrDetector
}
let jsQrLoadPromise=null;
function ensureJsQr(){
 if(typeof window.jsQR==='function')return Promise.resolve(window.jsQR);
 if(jsQrLoadPromise)return jsQrLoadPromise;
 const urls=[
  'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jsqr@1.4.0/dist/jsQR.js',
  'https://unpkg.com/jsqr@1.4.0/dist/jsQR.js',
  'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jsQR/1.4.0/jsQR.min.js'
 ];
 jsQrLoadPromise=new Promise(resolve=>{
  let i=0;
  const next=()=>{
   if(typeof window.jsQR==='function'){resolve(window.jsQR);return}
   if(i>=urls.length){resolve(null);return}
   const s=document.createElement('script');s.src=urls[i++];s.async=true;
   const timer=setTimeout(()=>{s.remove();next()},3500);
   s.onload=()=>{clearTimeout(timer);resolve(typeof window.jsQR==='function'?window.jsQR:null)};
   s.onerror=()=>{clearTimeout(timer);s.remove();next()};document.head.appendChild(s)
  };next()
 });
 return jsQrLoadPromise
}

function evaluateGpsPosition(pos){
 const z=gpsZones(),acc=Number(pos&&pos.accuracy)||999;
 // 실내 GPS가 지나치게 흔들릴 때 엉뚱한 구역을 해금하지 않는다.
 if(acc>140){renderGpsLocations(pos);return}
 // 한 위치에서는 가장 가까운 구역 하나만 해금 후보가 된다.
 // 이미 획득한 구역도 거리 비교에 포함해 같은 자리에서 다음 게임이 연쇄 해금되지 않게 한다.
 const ranked=GAME_ACQUIRE.map(loc=>{
  const zone=z[loc.code],target=zoneTarget(zone);
  if(!zone||!target)return null;
  return {loc,zone,target,centerD:metersBetween(pos,target),d:effectiveZoneDistanceM(pos,zone)}
 }).filter(Boolean).sort((a,b)=>a.centerD-b.centerD);
 const closest=ranked[0];
 if(closest){
  if(zoneInside(pos,closest.zone))unlockByGps(closest.loc.code);
  else if(closest.d <= (closest.zone.near||95) && !acquiredByAny(closest.loc.code))showDirection(closest.loc.code,closest.d,pos,closest.zone)
 }
 renderGpsLocations(pos)
}

   let dText='',dClass='';
   if(got){dText=viaQr?'✅ QR 보조 해금 완료':'✅ GPS 자동 획득 완료';dClass='inside'}
   else if(!zone){dText='▣ 현장 QR을 1회 스캔하면 이 위치가 GPS 기준점으로 저장됩니다.';dClass=''}
   else if(pos){const d=zoneDistanceM(pos,zone);dText=d<=0?'🎯 획득 구역 안':'📡 획득 구역까지 약 '+Math.round(d)+'m';dClass=d<=0?'inside':d<(zone.near||140)?'near':''}
   else dText='📡 GPS 확인을 시작하면 거리 표시';
   const badge=got?(viaQr?'QR획득':'GPS획득'):zone?'GPS준비':'QR기준점';
   return `<div class="locationRow ${zone?'confirmed':'pending'}"><div class="e">${g.icon}</div><div><

const COIN_CELEBRATION_MILESTONES=[1000,5000,10000,20000,30000,40000,50000,100000];
function coinCelebration(milestone){
 const s=$('#stage');if(!s)return;
 const label=Number(milestone||0).toLocaleString('ko-KR');
 let wrap=document.createElement('div');wrap.className='coinCelebrateScreen';
 wrap.innerHTML=`<div class="coinCelebrateCard"><div class="coinCelebrateBurst">🎉</div><div class="coinCelebrateTitle">보유 코인 달성!</div><div class="coinCelebrateNumber">🪙 ${label} COIN</div><div class="coinCelebrateText">축하하소! 다음 목표도 도전!</div><div class="coinCelebrateHint">잠시 후 자동으로 닫힙니다</div></div>`;
 s.appendChild(wrap);
 let r=s.getBoundingClientRect();
 for(let i=0;i<72;i++){let e=document.createElement('div');e.className='particle';e.textContent=['🎆','✨','🎉','⭐','🪙'][i%5];e.style.left=(r.width*(.08+Math.random()*.84))+'px';e.style.top=(r.height*(.22+Math.random()*.55))+'px';e.style.setProperty('--dx',(Math.random()*320-160)+'px');e.style.setProperty('--dy',(-110-Math.random()*220)+'px');e.style.setProperty('--rot',(Math.random()*560-280)+'deg');s.appendChild(e);setTimeout(()=>e.remove(),2600)}
 tone('clear');buzz([60,30,100,30,150,35,210]);
 let removed=false;
 function closeCelebration(){if(removed)return;removed=true;wrap.classList.add('closing');setTimeout(()=>wrap.remove(),260)}
 setTimeout(closeCelebration,5200)
}
function crossedCoinMilestones(beforeCoins,afterCoins){
 return COIN_CELEBRATION_MILESTONES.filter(v=>beforeCoins<v&&afterCoins>=v)
}
function playCoinMilestones(list){

 function clearHole(h,cancel=true){
  if(cancel&&expireTimers.has(h)){clearTimeout(expireTimers.get(h));expireTimers.delete(h)}
  h.innerHTML='';h.dataset.kind='';h.dataset.hit='';h.classList.remove('pop');h.style.transform='';h.style.zIndex=''
 }
 function missHole(h){
  const kind=h.dataset.kind;if(!kind)return;
  expireTimers.delete(h);
  if(kind==='fish'||kind==='gold'){combo=0;hud()}
  clearHole(h,false)
 }
 function patternsForLevel(){
  const singles=[[4],[1],[3],[5],[7],[0],[2],[6],[8]];
  if(level===1)return singles.slice(0,5);
  const pairs=[[0,2],[3,5],[6,8],[0,8],[2,6],[1,7],[0,4],[4,8],[2,4],[4,6]];
  if(level===2)return singles;
  if(level===3)return singles.concat(pairs.slice(0,6));
  const triples=[[0,4,8],[2,4,6],[0,1,2],[3,4,5],[6,7,8],[0,3,6],[1,4,7],[2,5,8]];
  if(level===4)return pairs.concat(singles.slice(0,4));
  return pairs.concat(triples)
 }
 function activate(idx){
  const h=holes[idx];if(!h||h.dataset.kind)return false;
  const roll=Math.random(),coinRate=.075,friendRate=.055+level*.004,kind=roll<coinRate?'coin':roll<coinRate+.12?'gold':roll<coinRate+.12+friendRate?'friend':'fish';
  h.dataset.kind=kind;h.dataset.hit='0';
  h.innerHTML=kind==='coin'?'<span class="fishTargetIcon">🪙</span>':kind==='gold'?'<span class="fishTargetIcon">🐠</span>':kind==='fish'?'<span class="fishTargetIcon">🐟</span>':friend();
  if(kind!=='friend'){const fishScale=kind==='coin'?1.06:1+Math.min(.42,Math.floor(combo/3)*.07);h.style.transform=`scale(${fishScale})`;h.style.zIndex=String(5+combo)}
  h.classList.add('pop');
  expireTimers.set(h,setTimeout(()=>missHole(h),DWELL));return true
 }
 function spawnWave(){
  if(ended)return;wave++;
  const patterns=patternsForLevel();let pattern=patterns[Math.floor(Math.random()*patterns.length)].slice();
  // 고레벨일수록 가로/세로/대각선 등 복수 패턴 비율이 커지며, 이미 사용 중인 칸은 건너뛴다.
  if(level>=4&&pattern.length===1&&Math.random()<.55){const multi=patterns.filter(p=>p.length>=2);pattern=multi[Math.floor(Math.random()*multi.length)].slice()}
  let made=0;for(const idx of pattern)if(activate(idx))made++;
  if(!made){const free=holes.map((h,i)=>h.dataset.kind?null:i).filter(v=>v!==null);if(free.length)activate(free[Math.floor(Math.random()*free.length)])}
 }

 function restart(){if(sp)clearInterval(sp);sp=setInterval(spawnWave,interval())}

 function loop(ts){
  if(!alive)return;
  const dt=Math.max(0,Math.min(.033,(ts-last)/1000));last=ts;time-=dt;
  const st=cornerState(),sr=clamp(speed/NORMAL_MAX,0,1.18);

  /* DRIFT 없이 방향키만으로 커브를 돌면 횡G가 계속 누적되어 차가 바깥으로 크게 밀린다.
     반대 조향으로 어느 정도 버틸 수는 있지만 긴 고속커브는 DRIFT 없이 중앙 유지가 어렵다.
     DRIFT를 누른 동안에만 횡미끄러짐을 빠르게 지우고 차 위치를 중앙으로 정상화한다. */
  const driftActive=driftHeld&&st.strength>.06&&speed>70&&!brakeHeld;

  if(st.strength>.05&&!driftActive){
   const slipDir=-Math.sign(st.curve);
   const slipBuild=st.load*(.42+sr*.80);
   cornerSlip=clamp(cornerSlip+slipDir*slipBuild*dt,-.78,.78);
  }else if(driftActive){
   cornerSlip*=Math.max(0,1-dt*(8.0+st.load*5.0));
   if(Math.abs(cornerSlip)<.010)cornerSlip=0;
  }else{
   cornerSlip*=Math.max(0,1-dt*1.35)
  }

  if(!driftActive&&st.load>.05){
   /* 조향 목표 자체를 바깥으로 끌고 가는 횡G. */
   const outward=-Math.sign(st.curve)*st.load*(.16+sr*.25);
   targetX=clamp(targetX+(outward+cornerSlip*.75)*dt,-.99,.99)
  }else if(driftActive){
   /* 드리프트를 눌렀을 때만 목표 위치를 중앙으로 강하게 복구. */
   const centerRecover=-targetX*1.35;
   targetX=clamp(targetX+centerRecover*dt,-.94,.94)
  }

  if(steerDir){
   /* 일반 커브에서는 포스피드백 부하 때문에 조향력이 눌리고,
      드리프트 중에는 오히려 조향력이 살아난다. */
   const steerResistance=driftActive?1.25:Math.max(.45,1-st.load*.49);
   const steerRate=(.58+sr*.72)*steerResistance;
   targetX=clamp(targetX+steerDir*steerRate*dt,-.99,.99)
  }

  const response=driftActive?1.20:Math.max(.52,1-st.load*.44);
  playerX+=(targetX-playerX)*Math.min(1,dt*(5.3+speed/72)*response);

  if(!driftActive&&st.load>.05){
   /* targetX와 별개로 차체 자체에도 직접 횡력이 걸린다.

function bearingDeg(a,b){
 const y=Math.sin(rad(b.lng-a.lng))*Math.cos(rad(b.lat));
 const x=Math.cos(rad(a.lat))*Math.sin(rad(b.lat))-Math.sin(rad(a.lat))*Math.cos(rad(b.lat))*Math.cos(rad(b.lng-a.lng));

}

function bearingDeg(a,b){
 const y=Math.sin(rad(b.lng-a.lng))*Math.cos(rad(b.lat));
 const x=Math.cos(rad(a.lat))*Math.sin(rad(b.lat))-Math.sin(rad(a.lat))*Math.cos(rad(b.lat))*Math.cos(rad(b.lng-a.lng));
 return (Math.atan2(y,x)*180/Math.PI+360)%360
}
